% A three-page A6 interior (105 x 148 mm): 3 mm of bleed on the outer, top and bottom edges and none on the binding edge.
% Page 1 is bound on the left, page 2 on the right, page 3 on the left; the boxes are set per page from a shipout hook.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[paperwidth=108mm,paperheight=154mm,margin=0pt]{geometry}
\usepackage[cmyk]{xcolor}
\usepackage{eso-pic}
\AddToHook{shipout/before}{%
  \ifodd\value{page}
    \pdfvariable pageattr{/TrimBox [0 8.504 297.638 428.031] /BleedBox [0 0 306.142 436.535]}%
  \else
    \pdfvariable pageattr{/TrimBox [8.504 8.504 306.142 428.031] /BleedBox [0 0 306.142 436.535]}%
  \fi}
\pagestyle{empty}
\AddToShipoutPictureBG*{\color{cyan}\rule{\paperwidth}{\paperheight}}
\begin{document}
\mbox{}\newpage\mbox{}\newpage\mbox{}
\end{document}
